method:
Root: android/jadx-out/sources (S) and android/jadx-out/resources/res (R). Kotlin names come from `grep -m1 'compiled from: X.kt'` (obfuscated files keep it). apk_refs are S- or R-relative path:line, line = first line containing a literal anchor (class declaration when no anchor).
STEP 1 surfaces (whitelist). Start from R/navigation/nav_graph.xml destinations whose class is a runtime page: home.HomeFragment, groups.GroupsFragment, groupDetail.GroupDetailsActivity, scenes.ScenesFragment, sceneDetail.SceneDetailsActivity, centralFunction.CentralFunctionsActivity, devices.{lamp.LampDetailActivity, blinds.BlindDetailActivity, rtr.RtrDetailActivity, socket.SwitchSocketDetailActivity, controlSwitch.ControlSwitchDetailActivity, detectors.motionDetector.*, detectors.presenceDetector.*, miniActuator.MiniActuatorDetailActivity, blinds.parameter.ReferenceRunLoadingActivity}, main.MainActivity; add their child fragments/views: every Kotlin file named *Fragment/*Activity/*Sheet/*View/*ViewHolder/*Slider/*Wheel/*Adapter that such a page instantiates (t.C(...) fragment swaps, R.layout.* it inflates, custom-view tags in those layouts and their <include>s), the 4 obfuscated tab fragments found by `grep -rl 'compiled from: [A-Za-z]*CentralFunctionsFragment.kt' S` (p223u6/b, p125l6/c, B6/b, p265y6/a), SwitchMeasureSocketDeviceDetailActivity, PowerConsumptionFragment, SleepFragment, SimpleSwitchFragment, DimFragment, TunableWhiteFragment, BlindsFragment, RoomTemperatureFragment, DetectorSensorFragment, ControlSwitchConfigurationFragment, MiniActuatorConfigurationFragment, FavoritesFragment, DevicesFragment, ProxyConnectionLoadingActivity, BluetoothOffActivity, and (second sweep) DeviceInfoFragment, ConfigurationConsumptionFragment, BlindReferenceRunFragment. Out of this domain by package: timer/, scheduler/ (timers), devices/connection/ (connection flows), configuration/deviceParameter/ (parameters, except the detector current-brightness cell), scene/create/ (scene editing), meshnetwork/, project/, update/, settings/, onboarding/, addNewDevice/, projectSync/, featureToogle/.
STEP 2 ids (all lowercase, from code names, never wording): ui:screen:<kt> one per whitelisted Activity/Fragment/Sheet; ui:view:<kt> one per custom view/tile holder used there; ui:tile:<DeviceViewType constant> (home/devices/adapter/DeviceViewType.java, 11); ui:filter:<DeviceFilterView constant> (devices/DeviceFilterView.java, 8); ui:vm:<class>.<method> one per file `find S -name '<VM>$<method>$*.java'` for VM/delegate classes HomeViewModel DevicesViewModel FavoritesViewModel GroupsViewModel GroupDetailsViewModel ScenesViewModel SceneDetailsViewModel CentralFunctionsHelper DeviceDetailsViewModel LockFunctionViewModelDelegate KeepLowPowerDeviceAwakeViewModelDelegate LampViewModel SimpleSwitchViewModel DimViewModel TunableWhiteViewModel BlindsViewModel RoomTemperatureViewModel PowerConsumptionViewModel DetectorSensorViewModel ControlSwitchConfigurationViewModel MiniActuatorConfigurationViewModel DeviceInfoViewModel MainViewModel BluetoothOffViewModel ConfigurationConsumptionViewModel ReferenceRunLoadingViewModel (method = 2nd `$` segment; `$$inlined`/`$special`/`$Companion` skipped; VMs with no such files, e.g. BlindViewModel RtrViewModel SwitchSocketViewModel CentralFunctionsViewModel, have none); ui:uc:<UseCase> one per distinct `new <UseCase>.Params(` found in the scope files (all files of the whitelisted Kotlin names + their `$` coroutine files; I6/b.java excluded because it is an R8-merged click listener shared with timer screens), UpdateDeviceTypeGroup split per Params subclass as ui:uc:updatedevicetypegroup.<outer>.<inner> (9); ui:uc:loadinitialdevicestate added because ProxyConnectionLoadingViewModel holds it; ui:ctl:<class>.<action> for UI actions whose send is not inside a coroutine class (grep `CommunicateWithDevice.Params`/`UpdateDeviceTypeGroup.Params` in non-`$` scope files: Lamp/Socket/Blind/Rtr central-function VMs, G6/b detector sensitivity, dim and tunable-white +/- listeners); ui:state:<Capability kt> for every Capability class referenced (import or FQN) by a scope file whose value is rendered, plus non-capability state holders RtrConnectionMode, SleepMode, DeviceState(X7/a), reachability (Y7/AbstractC0916e S1/N1/Q1 -> ui:state:devicereachability) and favourite flag (M1 -> ui:state:isfavorite); ui:enum:<kt> for enums rendered by scope files; ui:msg:<string key> for each BaseDialog.a.*/snackbars.*/Banner/status text built in scope files, keyed by its title (or only) string resource; ui:unused:strings = second-sweep dead strings.
STEP 3 details: message semantics re-derived from the capability -> message builder (p234v7/*, A7/*) and resolver (data/mesh/resolver/*, F7/*) classes; timings from FlowOperatorsKt.h/f, H.b(ms), p256x9.c.L/M, f.K (sample)/f.r (debounce) calls; cross-checked against docs/android/network-logic.md 4-5 and docs/gap-analysis/control-and-state.md (only facts re-found in jadx are cited).
STEP 4 closure: collect every R.string.<k> in the scope files and every @string/<k> in R/layout files reachable from them (R.layout.* + <include layout>); each key must appear verbatim in some item's title/details; leftovers are appended mechanically to the item owning the source file as 'Other strings on this surface'; only exclusion: insert_*_description (app/utils/g.g, used solely by the ButtonLayout configuration dialog). Result: 0 unassigned.
STEP 5 second sweep (different angle): regex over strings.xml keys ^(device_detail|blind|rtr_|socket|boost|detector|lamp|state_|favorite|central_function|home_|scenes?_|lock_function|lock_|unlock|battery|dim|tunable|consumption|presence|motion|pir_|puck|sleep|wake|proxy|no_proxy|bluetooth|device_not|quick|room_temperature|temperature|common_device|common_unit|unit_|forced|walking|current|power|energy|price|update_available|cloud|exploration|group_devices|groups_|switched|swipe|wind) minus keys already named; each hit was classified as (a) referenced by an in-domain surface -> surface added (this found ConfigurationConsumptionFragment, ReferenceRunLoadingActivity, BlindReferenceRunFragment, detector current-brightness cell), (b) referenced only by out-of-domain screens (blind_detail_parameter_*, rtr_*_mode_* on RtrModesFragment presets, scene_* creation, user_mode_* role switching, *_timer_empty_text, lock_function_* rocker-connection subtitles) -> left to other domains, (c) referenced nowhere (`grep -rhoE 'R\.string\.[A-Za-z0-9_]+' S` union `@string/` in R except values/strings.xml, values/public.xml) -> ui:unused:strings. Class-name angle: every Kotlin UI name in the whitelist has a ui:screen/ui:view/ui:tile item; every Capability referenced by scope files is either a ui:state item or only a lambda type parameter (TunableWhiteDefault*/RangeSetup*, PublicationCapability).
Rerun = repeat steps 1-5; ids are pure functions of class/method/enum/string names, so an unchanged APK yields the same list. Sorted by id. STEP 6 (adversarial verification pass, different angles; rerun = same scripts): (a) import graph: every class under S/de/jung/junghome/domain/interactors/** that `extends UseCase<` or `extends FlowUseCase<` and is named in an `import de.jung.junghome.domain.interactors.<pkg>.<Name>;` line (top-level package included) of any .java file under S/de/jung/junghome/app/ui/{home,groups,groupDetail,scenes,sceneDetail,centralFunction,main,proxy,bluetooth,base,shared,devices}/** except the out-of-domain subpackages devices/connection/, devices/blinds/setup/, devices/controlSwitch/buttonLayout/, devices/rtr/modes/ (opened from ConfigurationActivity), shared/picker, shared/weekday, shared/success, shared/deviceparameter must have a ui:uc:<name lowercase> item (catches use cases run without `new X.Params(` or from R8-merged listeners such as groupDetail/b.java); (b) instantiation: every `new <pkg>.a()`/`b()` fragment created by a whitelisted page whose file says `compiled from: *Fragment.kt` gets ui:screen:<kt> (icon pickers, NameConfigFragment) and its view model's `$<method>$` files get ui:vm items; (c) custom views: every `<de.jung.junghome.app.ui.devices.*>` tag in a layout reachable from the scope files (R.layout.* + <include>) gets ui:view:<class lowercase>; generic widgets from app/ui/shared (Divider, Skeleton*, EmptyView, CardToolbar, pickers, sliders of config pages) carry no device function and stay out; (d) navigation: every android:name destination in R/navigation/*.xml under an in-domain package is a ui:screen item or in an excluded subpackage. Items added by this pass: ui:screen:groupiconselectionfragment, ui:screen:nameconfigfragment, ui:screen:sceneiconselectionfragment, ui:uc:checknameinput, ui:uc:connecttoproxy, ui:uc:deletegroup, ui:uc:observebluetoothstate, ui:uc:observecloudstatus, ui:uc:observedemomode, ui:uc:observemeshnetwork, ui:uc:observeprojectbubbleindicators, ui:uc:observeupdateavailable, ui:uc:removeinvaliddevices, ui:uc:requestsoftwareversion, ui:uc:resetdevice, ui:uc:toggledemomode, ui:uc:updatesceneicon, ui:view:controlswitchkeyassignmentview, ui:view:controlswitchview, ui:view:miniactuatorkeyassignmentview, ui:vm:demomodeawareviewmodel.deactivatedemomode, ui:vm:demomodeawareviewmodel.toggledemomode, ui:vm:nameconfigviewmodel.observedevice, ui:vm:nameconfigviewmodel.observegroup, ui:vm:nameconfigviewmodel.observescene, ui:vm:nameconfigviewmodel.updatename, ui:vm:sceneiconselectionviewmodel.observescene.

items.title: Central blinds position / open / close (home or area)
items.details: Open = o(0.0), close = o(100.0), slider = o(pct). Home: Move.Blinds -> Generic Level Set Unack 0xFEF6. Area: per blind Generic Level Set Unacknowledged (0x8207) to its position element. Slats in an area: per-blind Level Set Unack to the slat element (p125l6/c.f).

items.title: Detector PIR segment sensitivity (drag)
items.details: On release: LBC Admin Property Set 0x6008 (PIR A), 0x6009 (PIR B), 0x600A (PIR C, presence only) [raw u8 = round(pct/100*255)], ack; steps 0/25/50/75/100 %.

items.title: Dim +/- buttons
items.details: + : min(current+1 %, range max); - : current-1 %, or 0 (off) when already at the range minimum; sent immediately as Light Lightness Set (no hold-to-dim, no Generic Level/Delta/Move for lamps anywhere).

items.title: Central lamps on/off (home or area)
items.details: Home: UpdateDeviceTypeGroup Toggle.Lamps -> Generic OnOff Set Unack 0xFEF5. Area: per lamp in the area a Generic OnOff Set Unacknowledged (0x8203) to the lamp OnOff element (CommunicateWithDevice UPDATE, waitForStatus=false).

items.title: Central thermostats target temperature (home or area)
items.details: Home: TargetTemperature.Rtrs -> Level Set Unack 0xFEF9. Area: per-RTR Generic Level Set Unacknowledged to its set-point element.

items.title: Central sockets on/off (home or area)
items.details: Home: Toggle.Sockets -> Generic OnOff Set Unack 0xFEF8. Area: per-socket Generic OnOff Set Unacknowledged to each socket OnOff element.

items.title: Colour temperature +/- buttons
items.details: +/- 1 % of the 2000..10000 K scale (80 K), bounded by the CTL temperature range; sent via the 500 ms debounced Light CTL Set.

items.title: Battery indicator enum
items.details: BATTERY_GOOD 2, BATTERY_LOW 1, BATTERY_CRITICAL 0, BATTERY_UNKNOWN 3 (Generic Battery flags bits 3:2).

items.title: Blind operation mode enum
items.details: BLINDS 0, SHUTTER 1, AWNING 3, UNKNOWN 4.

items.title: Home filter enum
items.details: FAVORITE, LAMP, BLIND, RTR, SOCKET, CONTROL_SWITCH, DETECTOR, MINI_ACTUATOR (see ui:filter:*).

items.title: Tile type enum
items.details: RTR, SWITCH_SOCKET, SOCKET, LAMP, BLIND, CONTROL_SWITCH, MOTION_DETECTOR, PRESENCE_DETECTOR, MINI_ACTUATOR, GATEWAY, UNKNOWN (see ui:tile:*).

items.title: Detector forced mode enum
items.details: INACTIVE 0, ON 3, OFF 2.

items.title: RTR HVAC mode enum
items.details: NONE 0, COMFORT 1, ECO 2, FREEZE 3 (unknown byte -> NONE); buttons Comfort / ECO / Frost.

items.title: Push-button layout enum
items.details: See ui:state:buttonlayoutcapability.

items.title: Blind step command
items.details: Decrease = -1 (open/up), Increase = +1 (close/down), Stop = 0 -> Generic Delta Set delta.

items.title: Lock command enum
items.details: b = 0 (none/unlock), a = 1 (enforce value), C0006c = 2 (lock current state), e = 3, d = 0xFF; locked = not b and not d.

items.title: Lock priority
items.details: a = 0xFE lock-out protection, c = 0xFF wind alarm, b(n) = normal (1 used by the app).

items.title: Consumption chart range
items.details: DAILY (0x5010, "24h Report"), THIRTY_ONE_DAYS (0x5011, "31 days report"). socket_measure_type_monthly is unused.

items.title: On/off enum
items.details: ON, OFF; null = unknown (skeleton; toggle treats unknown as ON -> sends OFF).

items.title: Sleep mode
items.details: DeviceAwake, DeviceNotAwake, DeviceNotAvailable.

items.title: RTR slider value mode
items.details: Current / Target (label rtr_detail_display_mode_current_temperature / _target_temperature).

items.title: Home filter tab BLIND
items.details: Shown when BlindDevice (C0892b); label home_blind_tab_description="Shading". Selecting it shows DevicesFragment with the matching DeviceFilter (Lamp/Blind/Rtr/Socket/ControlSwitch/Detector/MiniActuator); list sorted favourites first, then by name.

items.title: Home filter tab CONTROL_SWITCH
items.details: Shown when ControlSwitchDevice (AbstractC0914c) and the user is admin; label home_control_tab_description="Sensors". Selecting it shows DevicesFragment with the matching DeviceFilter (Lamp/Blind/Rtr/Socket/ControlSwitch/Detector/MiniActuator); list sorted favourites first, then by name.

items.title: Home filter tab DETECTOR
items.details: Shown when detector (AbstractC0915d) and the user is admin; label home_detector_tab_description="Motion detection". Selecting it shows DevicesFragment with the matching DeviceFilter (Lamp/Blind/Rtr/Socket/ControlSwitch/Detector/MiniActuator); list sorted favourites first, then by name.

items.title: Home filter tab FAVORITE
items.details: Shown when any device exists; label home_favorite_tab_description="Favourites". Selecting it shows FavoritesFragment.

items.title: Home filter tab LAMP
items.details: Shown when LampDevice (i0: switch/dim/TW/measure lamp); label home_lamp_tab_description="Light". Selecting it shows DevicesFragment with the matching DeviceFilter (Lamp/Blind/Rtr/Socket/ControlSwitch/Detector/MiniActuator); list sorted favourites first, then by name.

items.title: Home filter tab MINI_ACTUATOR
items.details: Shown when MiniActuatorDevice and the user is admin; label home_mini_actuator_tab_description="Binary inputs". Selecting it shows DevicesFragment with the matching DeviceFilter (Lamp/Blind/Rtr/Socket/ControlSwitch/Detector/MiniActuator); list sorted favourites first, then by name.

items.title: Home filter tab RTR
items.details: Shown when RtrDevice; label home_rtr_tab_description="Temperature". Selecting it shows DevicesFragment with the matching DeviceFilter (Lamp/Blind/Rtr/Socket/ControlSwitch/Detector/MiniActuator); list sorted favourites first, then by name.

items.title: Home filter tab SOCKET
items.details: Shown when SocketDevice (p0); label home_socket_tab_description="Current". Selecting it shows DevicesFragment with the matching DeviceFilter (Lamp/Blind/Rtr/Socket/ControlSwitch/Detector/MiniActuator); list sorted favourites first, then by name.

items.title: Cloud offline dialog
items.details: cloud_offline_dialog_title="No synchronization possible"; cloud_offline_dialog_message="You are using an online synchronized project. Without an internet connection to the cloud, changes to the project cannot be made and shared.\n\nPlease check your connection."; icon ic_no_wifi_bubble. Shown when tapping an editing control disabled because the synced project cloud is offline.

items.title: Connections could not be loaded (push-button / RTR pages)
items.details: common_connections_not_loaded_dialog_title="Connection could not be loaded"; common_connections_not_loaded_dialog_text="The connection query failed. Navigate back one step and reopen this view."; buttons common_try_again / common_abort.

items.title: Generic error dialog
items.details: common_error_title="Oh no!" / common_error_message="Something seems to have gone wrong. Please try again." (or device_create_connection_error_dialog_message); also ErrorView with common_try_again and favourites removal failure (common_error_message).

items.title: Connection saved snackbar
items.details: control_switch_connection_successful_text="Connection successful!" (after a key/input assignment was saved).

items.title: Power saving mode info dialogs (push-button / puck)
items.details: control_switch_sleep_mode_title="Power saving mode"; control_switch_sleep_mode_dialog_text="After each use, the button is put into energy-saving mode. For configurations within the JUNG HOME app, the button must be woken up.\n\nThe button can also be operated in energy-saving mode."; update_walltransmitter_no_wake_up_title="Your button is not responding?" / update_walltransmitter_no_wake_up_text="In this case, the battery is usually empty and your button has switched off. Please replace the battery."; puck: puck_battery_no_reaction="Your Puck does not react?" / update_puck_no_wake_up_text="In this case, the battery is usually empty and your Puck has switched off. Please replace the battery."; state words common_active / common_inactive.

items.title: Rename failed dialog
items.details: device_detail_error_change_name_failed_title="Unable to update name"; device_detail_error_change_name_failed_message="Updating the name failed".

items.title: Device not reachable dialog + label
items.details: device_not_reachable_title="No connection"; device_not_reachable_description="Currently, no connection can be made to your device. Check the power supply. A hardware reset may be necessary."; suggestions list common_check_power_supply="Check power supply", common_restart_app="Restart app", common_perform_hardware_reset="Perform a hardware reset"; button common_ok; icon ic_error_bubble. Shown when tapping the header of an unreachable (non-battery) device (activities: BaseActivity.f0, fragments: BaseFragment); the same title is the tile/header "No connection" label.

items.title: Manual reset needed after removing a device
items.details: device_reset_manually_dialog_title="Manually reset the device"; device_reset_manually_dialog_message="Your device could not be reset automatically. Please perform a manual factory reset to be able to operate the device again." - after removing a device that could not be reset over the mesh (long-press remove on Devices/Favourites; remove dialog device_remove="Delete device" / device_remove_message="The device is being completely removed from your project. You can add it back by pairing again.").

items.title: Favourite added/removed snackbars
items.details: Device: favorite_device_add_snackbar_message="Device marked as a favourite." / favorite_device_remove_snackbar_message="Device removed as a favourite."; area: favorite_group_add_snackbar_message / favorite_group_remove_snackbar_message; scene: favorite_scene_add_snackbar_message / favorite_scene_remove_snackbar_message.

items.title: Bluetooth/location permission required
items.details: permissions_import_dialog_title="Bluetooth connection required"; permissions_import_dialog_body="To find Bluetooth devices, the location of the device is required in this Android version. Please adjust the permissions for this.".

items.title: Proxy connection state text
items.details: proxy_connection_established="Devices conntected" (auto-hides after 4 s) / no_proxy_connection="No connection to Mesh" (blinking).

items.title: Unlink actuator from thermostat
items.details: remove_rtr_connection_dialog_title="Delete link"; remove_rtr_connection_dialog_text="Are you sure you want to delete this link?"; loading remove_rtr_connection_loading_text="The link will be deleted."; success snackbar rtr_connection_successful_removed_text="Link deleted."; error remove_rtr_connection_error_dialog_title="Deletion failed" / remove_rtr_connection_error_dialog_text="The link between your devices could not be deleted. Please check the status of your device and try again.".

items.title: Delete scene / area / device dialogs
items.details: scene_detail_remove_dialog_title="Delete scenes" / scene_detail_remove_dialog_message="The scene will be permanently deleted. All devices remain present and operable in the app."; area: group_detail_remove_dialog_title / group_detail_remove_dialog_message="The area is permanently deleted. All devices contained remain in the app and operable."; device: device_remove / device_remove_message; confirm common_remove.

items.title: Scene: device not reachable
items.details: scenes_device_not_reachable_title="Device not reachable"; scenes_device_not_reachable_message="No settings are possible without a connection. Please go to your device and operate it to re-establish the connection.".

items.title: Feature not available for 2-channel-insert devices
items.details: series_timer_scene_not_available_title="Feature not available"; series_timer_scene_not_available_text="This device was created from a two-channel insert. Unfortunately, it is not yet possible to create automations and scenes for this device. \n\nUpdate this device to be able to use automations." (device info page; also timers/scenes). Device naming fallback strings device_name_mini_actuator, device_name_mini_actuator_blind, device_name_puck_common.

items.title: Firmware update available snackbar
items.details: update_available_snackbar_title="Software update available.", action update_available_snackbar_action_text="View" -> UpdateActivity for this device.

items.title: New user role banner
items.details: user_mode_new_banner_title="New: Admin and member mode"; admin: user_mode_new_banner_message_admin="You are now an admin in this project. Take a look at what you can do in admin mode."; member: user_mode_new_banner_message_member="You have been added as a member in this project. Take a look at what you can do in member mode."; action user_mode_new_banner_action_text="More information".

items.title: Analytics / crash-report consent settings
items.details: Two switches (app_conditions_settings_crashlytics_* / app_conditions_settings_analytics_*) that opt the app into Firebase Crashlytics and Firebase Analytics (ToggleCrashlytics / ToggleAnalytics store the flag and enable the SDK collection), plus a 'read more' link to the privacy policy.

items.title: Central control - blinds tab
items.details: Blinds position slider with "%d%%" readout (common_percentage), open (0 %) / close (100 %) buttons, stop button (blind_stop_movement) and a SlatSlider. Position/open/close -> ui:ctl:blindcentralfunctionsviewmodel.position; stop -> OpenClose.Blinds(Stop) / OpenClose.Group(Stop, area); slats -> Move.Slats (home) or per-device unicast (area).

items.title: Blind / shutter / awning detail page
items.details: Tabs: Blind control (BlindsFragment) and Timer (timerProfilesFragmentButton). Header power button hidden (not an OnOff device).

items.title: Reference-run step in blind setup / parameters
items.details: Card blind_reference_run_title ("reference run") + blind_reference_run_description; starts ReferenceRunLoadingActivity.

items.title: Blind control tab (position, slats, arrows, stop, lock/wind alarm)
items.details: Blinds slider (thumb = target % if known else present %, shaded = present %; "%d %" text), up/down arrows, stop button (blind_stop_movement), SlatSlider only for BLINDS operation mode (0x1104 = 0) and disabled at 0 % (fully open); LockFunctionView of type blind (lock-out protection + wind alarm). All controls disabled while unreachable, while the page-open Gets are pending, while the lock state is unknown, or while locked. 0 % = open (level -32768), 100 % = closed (+32767); nothing inverted for shutter/awning.

items.title: Bluetooth-off blocking screen
items.details: Shown when the phone Bluetooth adapter is off: bluetooth_turn_on_title / bluetooth_turn_on_description; closes itself when Bluetooth comes back (observeConnection).

items.title: Central control (all devices of a type, home-wide or per area)
items.details: Tabs (IconToggleButtons) RTR / socket / lamp / blind, each only if such devices exist (CentralFunctionsHelper.getAvailableDevices); arg groupAddress = -1 for the whole home, else the area group. Empty: central_function_no_devices_title / central_function_no_devices_message. Descriptions central_function_description_lamps/_sockets/_blinds/_rtrs with suffix central_function_description_in_app ("in the JUNG HOME") or central_function_description_in_group ("in %s"). Tab fragments: ui:screen:lampcentralfunctionsfragment, ...socket..., ...blind..., ...rtr.... Other strings on this surface: central_function_description_blinds="All blinds %s"; central_function_description_rtrs="All temperature regulators %s"; central_function_description_sockets="All sockets %s".

items.title: Central control entry card
items.details: Compose card titled central_function_sheet_title ("Central control") used on the favourites dashboard (subtitle central_function_sheet_home_sub_title) and the area detail page; tap opens CentralFunctionsActivity.

items.title: Terms of use / privacy policy consent gate
items.details: ConditionType App (first start), MultiUserBeforeProjectView (before project synchronisation) and MultiUserBeforeCameraView (before the QR scanner): shows app_conditions_privacy_policy_* text with links (app_conditions_link_text, privacy_url, opened via an intent chooser app_conditions_intent_chooser_title) and a link to the consent settings (app_conditions_link_settings_text -> ui:screen:appconditionssettingsactivity); accepting stores a preference flag.

items.title: Consumption display settings + counter reset (measuring socket / lamp)
items.details: Configuration tab of measuring devices deciding which metering displays the runtime consumption page shows: Current Power (socket_active_power_info_title / socket_active_power_info_explanation), Energy consumption (socket_consumption_info_title / socket_consumption_info_explanation) with Reset button, Electricity cost (socket_consumption_price_title / consumption_price_info_explanation, price entry consumption_price_edit_label "in cents per kWh"); each with a "Preview" (socket_preview_label) of the live card. kWh = Wh/1000 on this page. Other strings on this surface: common_off="Off"; common_on="On".

items.title: Push-button key assignment view (what each rocker does)
items.details: ControlSwitchView (selectable rocker/key areas) + per key group (Top/Bottom) "Press"/"Hold" interaction cards (control_switch_item_key_press / _hold, control_switch_item_key_action_undefined = "No interaction"); gateway note field. Editing = device-settings domain; runtime-relevant: on open reads Generic Battery (waitForStatus=false) and lock functions of linked outputs; shows ConnectionSuccessfulSnackbar (control_switch_connection_successful_text). Other strings on this surface: control_switch_bottom_center_description="What do you want the bottom operating area to control?"; control_switch_bottom_left_description="What do you want the bottom left operating area to control?"; control_switch_bottom_right_description="What do you want the bottom right operating area to control?"; control_switch_center_description="What should the button control?"; control_switch_item_key_group_bottom="Bottom"; control_switch_item_key_group_top="Top"; control_switch_left_description="What do you want the left operating area to control?"; control_switch_right_description="What do you want the right operating area to control?"; control_switch_top_center_description="What do you want the top operating area to control?"; control_switch_top_left_description="What do you want the bottom left operating area to control?"; control_switch_top_right_description="What do you want the top right operating area to control?"; gateway_connection_note="Note"; gateway_selection_placeholder_text="Here you can record which function you have stored for this device in your IoT system."; scene_connection_subtitle="Scene".

items.title: Wall transmitter / push-button detail page
items.details: Header: rocker icon (ic_switch_on_gang_rocker for 1-gang / ic_two_rocker_control_switch), subtitle = button layout text (switch_layout_type_*), battery status icon (ui:state:batterycapability). ControlSwitchSleepModeView banner shown for battery devices while SleepMode = DeviceNotAwake (control_switch_sleep_mode_text, image ic_wake_up_one/two_gang_control_switch); hidden on DeviceAwake; keep-alive cancelled on DeviceNotAvailable. Content = ControlSwitchConfigurationFragment. Other strings on this surface: control_switch_detail_status="Structure".

items.title: Detector tab: activation area, PIR sensitivity, walking test, controlled function
items.details: DetectorView activation-area diagram (detector_activation_area) with per-segment sensitivity (drag) and segment highlight during the walking test; "What should the detector control?" card (detector_connection_title, common_select_function) = connection flow; Walking test card (device_parameter_detector_test_enable_title / _subtext, button _start / _stop). No live motion or lux indicator outside the walking test. Other strings on this surface: device_parameter_detector_test_enable_start="Start walking test"; pir_sensor_a_description="A"; pir_sensor_b_description="B"; pir_sensor_c_description="C".

items.title: Common device detail page frame (header, favourite, reachability, lock badge, settings, timers)
items.details: Base class of every device detail activity (DeviceDetailsActivity.kt). DeviceDetailHeader: device icon, editable name (rename -> updateDeviceName, 300 ms debounce; error device_detail_error_change_name_failed_title/message), favourite star (toggleFavorite + snackbar favorite_device_add/remove_snackbar_message, haptic), power/action button (enabled only when reachable and not RTR-controlled/forced), "No connection" label (device_not_reachable_title) when !S1(); tap on header while unreachable (non-battery) shows the not-reachable dialog; lock icon (ic_function_lock_closed / ic_lock_wind) when locked, tap scrolls to the LockFunctionView. Toolbar gear (menu_device_details/action_settings, admin only) opens ConfigurationActivity. Timer tab hosts TimerProfilesFragment (old mesh) or JHSchedulerScheduleListFragment (X1() = new mesh version) - timers domain. Update-available snackbar (checkForUpdate).

items.title: Device info / diagnostic page (Specifications)
items.details: Configuration tab "info": controllable elements (device_info_device_button_layout_label), areas and scenes counts (DeviceInfoStatusCard "x / y"), Specifications (device_info_label): Software-Version (device_info_software_version, SIG Manufacturer prop 0x001A formatted "a.b.c.d") + "(Update available)" link, serial number, App.-Ctrl. SW-Ver. (stm32_version_title, RTR only, Manufacturer prop 0x0005 via STM32VersionCapability) + update link, Manufacturer (device_info_company_label), Hardware Revision (device_info_hardware_revision_label, SIG Manufacturer prop 0x0010 via GenericPropertyGet 0x822B). Reset error view (common_error_title/message, common_try_again). Other strings on this surface: device_info_serial_number_label="Serialnumber".

items.title: Device list for one device-type filter
items.details: RecyclerView of item_device tiles (DevicesAdapter). Tap tile = open the device detail activity for its class (app/utils/g.k); tap action icon = ToggleDevice; long-press = popup_window_long_press_default (common_rename / common_remove) only when user role allows editing and cloud status permits. On observe it calls LoadStateForDevices for the listed devices (ui:uc:loadstatefordevices). Emits UnreachableIndicesEvent to redraw tiles whose reachability changed. After "remove" of an unreachable device: dialog device_reset_manually_dialog_title / device_reset_manually_dialog_message.

items.title: Brightness tab
items.details: Title dim_title ("Brightness"); DimSlider 0..100 % bounded by the lamp's lightness range (LightnessRange min/max); - / + buttons step 1 % (minus below the range minimum goes to 0 = off); LockFunctionView (switch type). Slider values sampled every 500 ms -> Light Lightness Set; incoming Lightness Status debounced 300 ms before redrawing.

items.title: Favourites dashboard (devices, areas, scenes, central control card)
items.details: Sections: "Devices" (favorite_devices_title, device tiles = ui:view:deviceviewholder with toggle action), "Areas" (groups_header, small area cards), "Scenes" (scenes_title, tap = ActivateScene recall). Data = ObserveDevices(DeviceFilter.IsFavorite) + ObserveGroups(GroupFilter.IsFavorite) + ObserveScenes(SceneFilter.IsFavorite). SearchView filters the lists (common_search_hint, empty result common_search_empty). Empty state favorite_empty_title="Favourites" / favorite_empty_message="Make devices, areas or scenes favourites in the respective view for them to show here.". A "Central control" compose card (central_function_sheet_title, subtitle central_function_sheet_home_sub_title) opens CentralFunctionsActivity without groupAddress (whole home). Long-press on device/area/scene opens the rename/remove popup (remove dialogs device_remove / group_detail_remove_dialog_title / scene_detail_remove_dialog_title). Tile toggle disabled when device is RTR-controlled (isActionDisabled).

items.title: Area detail page: devices with quick toggles + area central control
items.details: Header: area icon + editable name (groupNameTextInput), favourite toggle (favoriteGroupButton, snackbars favorite_group_add/remove_snackbar_message). Device list reuses DevicesAdapter tiles (tap = detail, action icon = ToggleDevice, state as on the Devices tab); LoadStateForDevices for the area devices on open. Central control card opens CentralFunctionsActivity with groupAddress = the area group address (room functions, ui:screen:centralfunctionsactivity). Admin-only: add devices (add_devices_to), swipe-to-remove device (swipe_to_delete_remove_device_text), delete area (group_detail_delete_group, dialog group_detail_remove_dialog_title/message, overlay group_detail_loading_message). Empty: group_detail_empty_message / _member. Errors: group_detail_error_create_failed_title/message, group_detail_error_update_failed_title/message, name validation group_detail_name_empty_error, group_detail_name_already_taken_error, common_name_format_error. Other strings on this surface: common_group="Area"; group_detail_create="Create"; group_detail_empty_message_member="As soon as devices are available in the area, you will find them here."; group_detail_error_create_failed_message="Creating the area failed"; group_detail_error_update_failed_message="Updating the area failed"; group_devices_title="Devices".

items.title: Area icon picker
items.details: Grid of GroupIcon values (title common_icons_title "Icons"), opened from the area page header; selection goes to GroupDetailsViewModel.updateGroupIcon (UpdateGroup).

items.title: Areas (rooms) tab
items.details: List of areas (groups_tab_title="Areas") as small cards: icon, name, "%d Devices" (group_devices_placeholder / group_devices_empty_placeholder), favourite marker. Tap opens GroupDetailsActivity. Empty state groups_empty_message / groups_empty_message_member; create button groups_create_title (admin). Long-press remove with group_detail_remove_dialog_*; removal overlay group_detail_loading_message. Toolbar carries ProxyStatusView, CloudStatusView and the demo "Discovery mode" indicator (exploration_mode_title, action_end_demo_mode). Other strings on this surface: group_function_blind="Shading"; group_function_light="Lighting"; group_function_light_and_switch="Lighting & Sockets"; group_function_switch="Sockets".

items.title: Home tab with device-type filter toggles
items.details: Top "Home" tab (home_tab_title). IconToggleGroup of up to 8 DeviceFilterView buttons (see ui:filter:*), each shown only if a device of that class exists; control-switch / detector / binary-input buttons additionally require the admin user role (HomeViewModel$observeData$1 z9 = userRoleService flag); if the selected filter disappears the first visible one is selected (HomeViewModel$selectTab). Child container shows FavoritesFragment for FAVORITE, DevicesFragment for the other filters. Empty project: compose empty view home_empty_title="no devices present", home_empty_description="Add JUNG HOME Bluetooth® devices to have them displayed here." / home_empty_description_member="As soon as there are devices in your JUNG HOME, you will find them here." (member role), button devices_add_device="Add Device to Network". Tab descriptions: home_favorite_tab_description, home_lamp_tab_description="Light", home_blind_tab_description="Shading", home_rtr_tab_description="Temperature", home_socket_tab_description="Current", home_control_tab_description="Sensors", home_detector_tab_description="Motion detection", home_mini_actuator_tab_description="Binary inputs".

items.title: Central control - lamps tab
items.details: All-on / all-off buttons (set the DimSlider to 100 / 0) and a DimSlider (0..100 %). On/off -> ui:ctl:lampcentralfunctionsviewmodel.onoff; slider -> UpdateDeviceTypeGroup Dim.Lamps (home, 0xFEF5) or Dim.Group(pct, areaAddress) (area).

items.title: Lamp detail page (switch / dim / tunable white / measuring lamp)
items.details: Tab buttons by device class: DimLampDevice(f0) -> Dim; SwitchLampDevice(q0) -> SimpleSwitch; TunableWhiteLampDevice(t0) -> Dim + Colour temperature; MeasureLampDevice(n0) -> Measure (PowerConsumptionFragment); plus Timer. Default tab = Dim, else Switch, else Measure. Header icon ic_lightbulb_on_secondary/off_primary; header subtitle "%d%% brightness" (device_detail_state, from LightLightness present %) for dimmers, "Switched on/off" (common_device_on/off) for switch/measure lamps. Header power button = ToggleDevice. RTR binding card (view_connection_mode_info_card): rtr_connection_info_text + "\n" + comma-joined RTR names, tabs hidden and controls disabled when ObserveRtrConnectionMode says controlled. ForcedOffView shown when the attached detector reports forced ON/OFF (ui:state:detectorforcedoffcapability); controls disabled unless forcedOffMode == INACTIVE and not RTR-controlled.

items.title: Legal: open-source licences and imprint
items.details: Settings > Legal (settings_legal_title): licences list (settings_licenses_title) and the publisher imprint (ImprintActivity, imprint_title). Static text only.

items.title: Main shell: bottom navigation, banners, proxy/bluetooth supervision
items.details: Bottom navigation Home / Areas / Scenes / Settings (nav_graph homesFragment, groupsFragment, scenesFragment, settingsFragment) with bubble indicators (ObserveProjectBubbleIndicators, ObserveUpdateAvailable); floating "+" menu add device / area / scene (admin). Banner for new user role (user_mode_new_banner_title, user_mode_new_banner_message_admin / _member, action user_mode_new_banner_action_text). Starts ConnectToProxy, observes Bluetooth state (-> BluetoothOffActivity) and missing-location-permission dialog (permissions_import_dialog_title/body). items.title: Mini actuator inputs view
items.details: Input cards E1/E2 (mini_actuator_first/second_input_title), connect-inputs switch (mini_actuator_connect_input_label_text/_description), function selection, MiniActuatorKeyAssignmentView (Press/Hold), edge evaluation (mini_actuator_input_edge_behaviour_label_text/_description, rising_input_edge / falling_input_edge). items.title: Mini actuator / puck (binary inputs) detail page
items.details: Header icon ic_puck (R1() = puck) or ic_mini_actuator, battery status icon for the battery puck. Content: SleepFragment while the battery puck is asleep, else MiniActuatorConfigurationFragment (inputs E1/E2, key assignment Press/Hold, connect inputs, edge evaluation rising/falling) - configuration domain.

items.title: Motion detector detail page
items.details: Header title motion_detector_title; hosts DetectorSensorFragment (2 PIR segments A/B). No power button, no lock.

items.title: Rename dialog for a device / area / scene (long-press)
items.details: Bottom sheet opened by long-press on Devices / Areas / Scenes / Favourites tiles: title common_rename_device / common_rename_group / common_rename_scene, description device_name_config_description / group_name_config_description / scene_name_config_description, labels device_info_device_name_label / device_info_options_label, error name_config_error; saves via NameConfigViewModel.updateName.

items.title: Onboarding tutorial pages
items.details: Pager of illustrated tutorial pages (onboarding_{devices,add_devices,groups,favorites,scenes,settings}_{title,subtitle}) explaining the app's tabs, shown from the welcome screen.

items.title: Android permissions overview (Bluetooth / location / camera)
items.details: Settings > Permissions (settings_permissions_title): shows the phone's Bluetooth adapter state (permissions_bluetooth_state_on / _off) and the Android runtime permissions the app uses (permissions_access, permissions_location for BLE scanning, permissions_camera for the project QR scanner) with granted / denied state (permissions_granted / permissions_denied).

items.title: Energy / power consumption tab (measuring socket, measuring lamp)
items.details: Spinner DAILY ("24h Report") / THIRTY_ONE_DAYS ("31 days report") -> ChartLine (Wh). Current power card (socket_active_power_info_title, value W rounded to 2 dp, "State" On/Off with ic_plugged_in/ic_not_plugged_in). Total consumption card (socket_total_consumption_info_title, Wh, operating hours socket_consumption_info_operating_hours) and electricity cost card (socket_consumption_price "%.2f €", price per kWh socket_consumption_price_per_cent "ct / kWh", example 100 Wh) - each card only if enabled on the configuration consumption page (local DeviceInfo flags). items.details: Header title presence_detector_title; hosts DetectorSensorFragment (3 PIR segments A/B/C).

items.details: Full-screen "Your JUNG HOME is being updated" (proxy_loading_new_connection_title) / "Bluetooth connection is established and the status of your devices is being updated." shown by AppStartService while the first proxy connection and state load run; "Skip" (proxy_loading_continue_without_connection). Other strings on this surface: proxy_loading_new_connection_description="Bluetooth connection is established and the status of your devices is being updated.".

items.title: Blind reference run (calibration) progress screen
items.details: Full-screen loading "Your blind is moved to the Fully-Opened reference position." (blind_reference_run_description) for running time + 10 s after Admin Set 0x110D = 1. No calibration state is read or shown anywhere else.

items.title: Thermostat control tab
items.details: RoomTemperatureSlider (arc 5..30 degC, 0.5 steps) with value label toggle Target/Current (rtr_detail_display_mode_target_temperature / _current_temperature; "%s°C"/"%s°"), Auto/Manu label (device_detail_rtr_operation_mode_auto/_manu) that toggles scheduler on tap; - / + buttons (±0.5 degC); quick programs (quick_programs_title) Frost / ECO / Comfort buttons (HvacMode FREEZE/ECO/COMFORT); Boost card (boost_mode_title, boost_mode_description, Start boost / Stop boost). Connected heating actuators list (compose) with remove link (remove_rtr_connection_dialog_*, loading remove_rtr_connection_loading_text, success rtr_connection_successful_removed_text, error remove_rtr_connection_error_dialog_*; explanation rtr_connected_devices_explanation / _participant). items.details: RoomTemperatureSlider (5..30 degC, 0.5 steps) setting the target temperature of all RTRs -> ui:ctl:rtrcentralfunctionsviewmodel.targettemperature (home: TargetTemperature.Rtrs -> 0xFEF9; area: per-device unicast unack).

items.title: Room thermostat detail page
items.details: Tabs: temperature control (RoomTemperatureFragment, allowOperationModeSwitch=true) and heating profiles (timers domain). No lock function, no power button.

items.title: Scene detail page (favourite + stored device states)
items.details: Shows the scene name/icon, favourite toggle (favorite_scene_add/remove_snackbar_message) and the list of devices with the state stored in the scene (SceneResultAdapter; RTR-controlled outputs labelled scenes_temperature_controlled, locked devices marked). items.title: Scene icon picker
items.details: Grid of SceneIcon values (title common_icons_title "Icons"), opened from the scene page header; selection sends UpdateSceneIcon.

items.title: Scenes tab: recall scenes
items.details: Grid of scene tiles (name, icon, favourite marker). Tap = ActivateScene(scene number) -> Scene Recall broadcast (ui:uc:activatescene); no "active scene" state is shown. Long-press = popup_window_long_press_scene (common_action_trigger_scene "Trigger scene" = same recall, rename, remove with dialog scene_detail_remove_dialog_title/message). Empty: scenes_empty_message; create button scenes_create_title (admin, opens scene editor = scenes domain).

items.title: App theme (system / light / dark)
items.details: Settings > Design: radio choice settings_design_system / settings_design_light / settings_design_dark, stored as a preference and applied with AppCompatDelegate night mode.

items.title: Settings tab (project and app settings hub)
items.details: Bottom-bar tab settings_tab_title. Section settings_project_settings_title: share via QR / synchronisation (net:uc:createqrcode, net:uc:createsyncedproject), settings_manage_my_project_title (ProjectActivity: share file net:ui:projectshare, gateway net:uc:getgatewayconfig, delete project net:uc:removelocaldata), gateway. Section settings_app_settings_title: firmware updates (mgmt:flow:checkforupdate), support, design, version history, permissions, legal, and the hidden mesh network entry (mgmt:debug:entry, 7 taps on the version text).

items.title: Switch tab (on/off illustration + lock functions) for switch lamps and sockets
items.details: Compose screen: large on/off illustration (ic_lamp_function_on/off for lamps, ic_socket_particles_on/off for sockets, app/utils/g.i) with "Switched on/off" text (read-only; switching is done with the header button). Lock card "Lock functions" / "Permanent On | Off" (lock_function_switch_title/description) with a Time limit picker (H:MM:SS, unit_hour) and Lock/Unlock device button (onToggleDeviceLockedClicked -> LockFunctionViewModelDelegate lock/unlock). On open: Generic OnOff Get if no cached state (requestGenericOnOffIfMissing). Other strings on this surface: lock_function_title="Lock functions".

items.title: Battery device sleep screen
items.details: Compose screen shown for sleeping battery devices: wake-up illustration (ic_wake_up_puck / ic_wake_up_one_gang_control_switch / ic_wake_up_two_gang_control_switch), text puck_sleep_mode_text or control_switch_sleep_mode_text, info dialog (puck_sleep_mode_dialog_text / control_switch_sleep_mode_dialog_text) and "does not react" link (puck_sleep_mode_battery_change_button_text / control_switch_sleep_mode_battery_change_button_text -> update_puck_no_wake_up_text / update_walltransmitter_no_wake_up_text: battery empty, replace it).

items.title: Central control - sockets tab
items.details: All sockets on / off buttons -> ui:ctl:socketcentralfunctionsviewmodel.onoff (home: Toggle.Sockets -> 0xFEF8; area: per-device unicast unack).

items.title: Support links (workbook, device manuals, report a problem)
items.details: Settings > Support: three rows that open external web pages in the browser: support_workbook (support_workbook_url), support_device_manuals (https://www.jung.group/JH-Catalogue), support_report_a_problem (https://www.jung.group/Customer-Centre). No logs or data are attached.

items.title: Measuring socket detail page
items.details: Tabs: consumption chart (PowerConsumptionFragment) and Timer. Header power button = ToggleDevice.

items.title: Switch socket detail page
items.details: Tabs: SimpleSwitch (on/off illustration + lock) and Timer. Header power button = ToggleDevice. RTR binding card (rtr_connection_info_text) as for lamps.

items.title: Colour temperature tab
items.details: Title tunable_white_title ("Colour temperature"); TunableWhiteWheel showing "%s K" (common_kelvin) rounded to 100 K, - / + buttons (1 % steps of the 2000..10000 K scale) bounded by the CTL temperature range; LockFunctionView. Changes debounced 500 ms -> Light CTL Set with current lightness.

items.title: App release notes (version history, post-update changelog)
items.details: Settings > Version history (settings_version_history): expandable per-version notes (version_history_show_more / show_less); AppChangelogActivity (app_changelog_title) shows the same bundled changelog once after an app update, gated by a stored last-seen version.

items.title: Splash / welcome screen (start directly or discover the demo)
items.details: Splash (1 s) that runs CheckForForcedAppUpdate (-> ForceUpdateActivity) and CheckForValidProject; with a project it opens MainActivity, otherwise shows welcome_sub_title with welcome_button_start_directly (-> ProjectStartupActivity: import a project file or search devices) and welcome_button_discover_app (demo project, ui:uc:toggledemomode), and the onboarding tutorial.

items.title: Current power (W)
items.details: Sensor Status first property 0x0081 Active Power Load Side, LE x0.1 W; shown with 2 decimals on the consumption page (polled every 5 s while open, also consumed from publications).

items.title: RTR current room temperature
items.details: Sensor Status (0x52) whose FIRST marshalled property is 0x004F Present Ambient Temperature: value = signed raw x 0.5 degC, clamped 5..30. Tile "Currently %.1f °C", slider secondary/Current value. Other properties of a multi-property status are ignored.

items.title: Battery indicator (wall transmitters, battery puck)
items.details: Generic Battery Status (0x8224): only flags bits 3:2 (battery indicator) used, level byte ignored. Icon: GOOD(2) -> ic_battery_medium, LOW(1) -> ic_battery_empty, CRITICAL(0) -> ic_battery_critical, UNKNOWN(3) or device unreachable -> ic_battery_unknown. Header status icon on push-button and mini-actuator pages only (not on tiles).

items.title: Blind operation mode (blind / shutter / awning)
items.details: LBC Admin property 0x1104 u8: 0 BLINDS (slat slider shown), 1 SHUTTER, 3 AWNING, 4 UNKNOWN; read on blind page open. Only runtime effect: slat slider visibility (nothing inverted).

items.title: RTR boost active
items.details: Admin 0x120D u8 1/0, polled every 5 s while the RTR page is open; while active Start/Stop boost toggles and slider + mode buttons are disabled.

items.title: Push-button layout text
items.details: Admin 0x5001 LayoutMode 0 ONE_TOP_ONE_BOTTOM, 1 ONE_ROCKER, 2 TWO_LEFT_TWO_RIGHT, 3 ONE_LEFT_TWO_RIGHT, 4 TWO_LEFT_ONE_RIGHT, 5 ONE_LEFT_ONE_RIGHT, 255 UNKNOWN -> tile/header text switch_layout_type_* and rocker drawing; also the keep-alive probe.

items.title: Detector forced ON/OFF (continuous on/off)
items.details: Admin 0x6016 u8 0 INACTIVE, 2 OFF, 3 ON read from the detector element when a lamp page opens; ForcedOffView on the load page, controls disabled while != INACTIVE. Read-only in the UI.

items.title: Device reachable / "No connection"
items.details: S1() reachable = failedMessagesCounter < 3 && !N1(); N1() = battery device (Q1: 1-/2-gang wall transmitter, battery puck) with >= 1 failed request. Counter set to 3 on request timeout, reset to 0 by any status from the device. Unreachable: tile "No connection" (not for battery devices), greyed icon, disabled toggle, detail header label + tap dialog device_not_reachable_*, battery icon unknown.

items.title: Mesh proxy connection state
items.details: DeviceState: Connected(macAddress) / CommunicationError(status) / c (connecting) / d(flag) -> ProxyStatusView text and colour.

items.title: Blind position / slat (percent closed)
items.details: Generic Level Status (0x8208) present AND target stored as pct = round((level+32768)*100/65535) (target := present in the short form; remaining time ignored). Tile uses present (Closed/Open/"To %d%% Closed"); slider thumb = target, shaded = present; slat % on SlatSlider.

items.title: On/off state (lamps, sockets, outputs)
items.details: From Generic OnOff Status (0x8204) PRESENT state (target/remaining ignored), also set by Lightness/CTL status (lightness != 0 -> ON). Shown as tile icon + "Switched on"/"Switched off", tile toggle checked, header power button, detail illustration, consumption "State On/Off". Unknown -> skeleton.

items.title: Binary input edge evaluation
items.details: Admin 0x5009 per input: rising / falling edge (rising_input_edge / falling_input_edge) shown on the inputs page.

items.title: Favourite flag
items.details: Local flag per device/area/scene: star on tiles, header toggle, favourites dashboard, sort order, initial state load.

items.title: Brightness %
items.details: Light Lightness Status (0x824E) present lightness -> pct = round(l*100/65535); detail header "%d%% brightness", DimSlider position. Not shown on tiles.

items.title: Dimmer lightness range (slider bounds)
items.details: Light Lightness Range Status (0x8258) [status][min u16][max u16] -> DimSlider range (percent of 65535); minus below min turns off.

items.title: Lock function state (locked / lock-out / wind alarm, time limit)
items.details: LBC Admin property 0x0009 status [cmd u8][priority u8][time u16 LE s][value...]: locked = cmd not in {0 (none), 0xFF}; priority 0xFE = lock-out protection, 0xFF = wind alarm (locked && prio 0xFF), other (1) = normal lock; time 0 = unlimited. Shown as lock badge on tiles/header (ic_function_lock_closed, ic_lock_wind), Lock/Unlock button text, wind alarm Start/End, disables all controls while locked; read on detail page open and after toggles.

items.title: Hardware revision / manufacturer (device info)
items.details: SIG Generic Manufacturer Property 0x0010 hardware revision (raw bytes) shown under Specifications.

items.title: Software version (device info)
items.details: SIG Manufacturer property 0x001A as ASCII digit string -> "a.b.c.d"; shown under Specifications; also gates RTR 0x120B support (>= 2.2.0.0).

items.title: Consumption history samples
items.details: LBC User property 0x5010 (DAILY: u16 big-endian x0.1 per hour, index i = i hours ago, 0xFFFF invalid) / 0x5011 (THIRTY_ONE_DAYS: u24 BE x0.1 per day) -> ChartLine.

items.title: Detector PIR sensitivities
items.details: Admin 0x6008 / 0x6009 / 0x600A u8 raw 0..255 per PIR segment A/B/C -> segment radius (0..100 %).

items.title: Operating hours
items.details: SIG Generic Admin Property 0x006D power-on time, hours (uint24 on air); "Operating hours" card.

items.title: Detector current brightness (lux)
items.details: LBC Manufacturer property 0x6004 u16 LE (lux), polled every 5 s on the detector parameter page (device_parameter_detector_light_situation_title / device_parameter_detector_light_situation_sub_title, unit_lx); never delivered as Sensor Status.

items.title: Detector live PIR trigger bits (walking test only)
items.details: LBC Manufacturer property 0x6005 u8 bitfield bit0 A, bit1 B, bit2 C -> DetectorView segment highlight. The only "motion detected" display in the app; not shown outside the walking test.

items.title: Detector walking test active
items.details: Admin 0x6001 u8 bool; button text Start/Stop walking test; drives the 1 s 0x6005 poll.

items.title: Output controlled by thermostat
items.details: RtrConnectionMode(controlled, rtr names): local DB (subscriptions); disables toggle on tiles/pages, shows "This device is controlled by a thermostat." + RTR names; parameters page shows rtr_connection_parameter_info_text.

items.title: RTR mode Comfort / ECO / Frost
items.details: LBC Admin 0x120B u8 0 NONE, 1 COMFORT, 2 ECO, 3 FREEZE (FW >= 2.2.0.0, SIG prop 0x001A). Highlights the active quick-program button.

items.title: RTR preset temperatures (old firmware mode derivation)
items.details: Admin 0x1203 Comfort / 0x1204 Eco / 0x1205 Frost preset (int16 LE degC x100). FW < 2.2.0.0: the highlighted mode is the preset equal to the current target; selecting a mode writes that preset as target.

items.title: RTR Auto / Manu
items.details: Admin 0x1246 u8 1 = AUTO (scheduler/heating profile active: "the temperature changes between Comfort and ECO modes"), 0 = MANU; 0x1249 RtrSchedulerFunctionStatus updates the same field.

items.title: Battery device awake/asleep
items.details: DeviceAwake / DeviceNotAwake / DeviceNotAvailable from the keep-alive; controls the sleep banner/SleepFragment.

items.title: RTR application controller version
items.details: LBC Manufacturer property 0x0005 (application image version) of the RTR, "App.-Ctrl. SW-Ver." with update link.

items.title: RTR target temperature (set-point)
items.details: Generic Level Status of the set-point element: pct -> t = 5 + 25*pct/100 (target preferred over present). Slider primary value "Target".

items.title: Total consumption (Wh)
items.details: SIG Generic Admin Property 0x006A TotalDeviceEnergyUse, LE integer Wh (kWh = /1000 on the configuration page); drives the cost calculation.

items.title: Colour temperature range
items.details: Light CTL Temperature Range Status (0x8263) [status][min K u16][max K u16] -> wheel bounds (default scale 2000..10000 K).

items.title: Colour temperature (and lightness) of TW lamps
items.details: Light CTL Status (0x8260) present lightness + present temperature; temperature pct = (K-2000)/8000*100; wheel shows K rounded to 100.

items.title: Blind tile
items.details: Present level +32767 -> "Closed" (blind_state_closed, ic_blinds_closed); -32768 -> "Open" (blind_state_open, ic_blinds_fully_open); else "To %d%% Closed" (blind_state_closing, present %, ic_blinds_closing). No action button, no slat, no moving indicator. Wind-alarm lock icon.

items.title: Push-button / wall transmitter tile
items.details: Icon ic_switch_on_gang_rocker (1-gang: Z7.a, Z7.i) or ic_two_rocker_control_switch; state text = button layout (switch_layout_type_one_key_text, _one_rocker_text, _2_2_text, _1_2_text, _2_1_text, _1_1_text) from ButtonLayout 0x5001; no action; battery devices never show "No connection".

items.title: Gateway tile
items.details: Icon ic_gateway; name only, no state, no action.

items.title: Lamp tile (switch, dim, tunable white, measuring lamp)
items.details: Icon ic_lightbulb_on_secondary / ic_lightbulb_off_primary; state "Switched on/off" (no brightness % on the tile); toggle action button (ToggleDevice).

items.title: Mini actuator / puck tile
items.details: Icon ic_mini_actuator (variants 0,1) or ic_puck (2..8); empty state text; no action. Outputs of the actuator/puck appear as separate lamp/socket/blind tiles.

items.title: Motion detector tile
items.details: Icon ic_detector_motion; static text "Motion detector"; no motion/lux state, no action.

items.title: Presence detector tile
items.details: Icon ic_detector_presence; static text "Ceiling presence detector"; no presence state, no action.

items.title: RTR tile
items.details: Icon ic_rtr; state text "Currently %.1f °C" (rtr_state_temperature_currently) from ActualTemperature (Sensor 0x004F), "-" until known; no action button; redraw only when temperature changes.

items.title: Measuring socket tile
items.details: Same holder as switch socket (I6.a case 7): socket icon by OnOff, "Switched on/off", toggle button. No power value on the tile.

items.title: Switch socket tile
items.details: Icon ic_socket_on / ic_socket by OnOff; state "Switched on"/"Switched off" (common_device_on/off); toggle action button (ToggleDevice).

items.title: Unknown device tile
items.details: Name only, no state.

items.title: Recall a scene (scene tile / favourite)
items.details: SceneRecallCapability(address 0xFFFF, scene number) -> Scene Recall Unacknowledged (0x8243) [scene u16 LE][tid], no transition/delay, one broadcast to all nodes. No feedback shown; the current scene is not displayed anywhere.

items.title: Scene editing: add devices
items.details: Scenes domain (Scene Store / SceneActionSetupSet).

items.title: Firmware update availability for a device
items.details: Compares the node software version (SIG Manufacturer prop 0x001A, "a.b.c.d") with the bundled firmware catalogue; result drives the update-available snackbar and the "(Update available)" links.

items.title: Name validation for device / area / scene names
items.details: Run inside CreateGroup / UpdateGroup / UpdateSceneName / UpdateDeviceData: Blank (null or blank name) -> group_detail_name_empty_error "Name cannot be blank"; NotAllowed (String.format(name) throws, e.g. a stray '%') -> common_name_format_error "The name contains invalid characters."; AlreadyTaken (another device / area / scene per CheckType already has the name) -> group_detail_name_already_taken_error "Name is already in use". No mesh traffic.

items.title: New user role banner check
items.details: Shows once after the user role changed (admin/member) -> Banner user_mode_new_banner_*.

items.title: Send one capability to a device (all runtime detail-page reads/writes)
items.details: Params(deviceId, capability, CommunicationType REQUEST (Get) | UPDATE (Set) | UNKNOWN, waitForStatus). Acked request to the element hosting the server model; 3 attempts x 3 s matched on source element + status opcode (vendor property requests also accept D1 27 05); on timeout the device failedMessagesCounter -> 3 (unreachable). If the proxy link is down the request fails immediately (DeviceNotReachable) except for battery devices whose requests are queued (docs/android/network-logic.md 4.1/5.1).

items.title: Change input layout (connect inputs)
items.details: Configuration (Admin 0x5001 layout); device-settings domain.

items.title: Connect to a mesh proxy (use case)
items.details: ConnectToProxy injected into MainViewModel and run by startConnectingToProxy (ui:vm:mainviewmodel.startconnectingtoproxy): GATT proxy scan/connect and reconnect loop.

items.title: Create area (admin)
items.details: Configuration: new group address + subscriptions (network domain).

items.title: Remove device from area

items.title: Delete scene
items.details: Scenes domain.

items.title: Stop detector walking test
items.details: Admin Set 0x6001 PresenceTest [00] then Admin Set 0x6003 PresenceControl [00] (ack). Also sent automatically after 300 000 ms and when the page is destroyed (DetectorSensorViewModel.onCleared).

items.title: Start detector walking test
items.details: Admin Set 0x6001 PresenceTest [01] then Admin Set 0x6003 PresenceControl [01] (ack); auto-disable after 300 000 ms (5 min, device_parameter_detector_test_enable_subtext). While active the page polls 0x6005 every 1 s.

items.title: Heating actuators bound to an RTR
items.details: Local DB: devices whose OnOff server subscribes to the RTR OnOff-client publish address; shown as the RTR connected-devices list.

items.title: Detector controlled function
items.details: Reads the target of the detector OnOff-client publication (load / area / function) for the "What should the detector control?" card.

items.title: Scene members
items.details: Devices stored in a scene with their stored action.

items.title: Scenes of a device
items.details: Device info scenes count card.

items.title: Is this output controlled by a thermostat?
items.details: True when any RTR publishes its OnOff client to this output; tiles then disable the toggle and scene lists show scenes_temperature_controlled.

items.title: Keep a battery device awake while its page is open
items.details: Emits SleepMode DeviceAwake / DeviceNotAwake / DeviceNotAvailable; keep-alive = acked Admin Get 0x5001 ButtonLayout every 6 s (skipped while another BLE process runs), retry after 1 s on timeout. Used by ControlSwitchDetailViewModel and MiniActuatorViewModel (battery puck).

items.title: App start: time broadcast + favourites state load
items.details: Run behind the proxy loading screen: Time Set (0x5C) unack -> 0xFFFF (TAI seconds since 2000, TAI-UTC delta 37, zone offset/15+64); Manufacturer Property Get 0xC001/0xC002/0xC003 to gateways; then LoadStateForDevices for favourite devices only (M1()).

items.title: Bulk state read for listed devices
items.details: Reachable devices in chunks of 5, 300 ms between chunks; per device only if no cached value: Generic OnOff Get (0x8201) -> OnOff element (lamps/sockets/outputs); Generic Level Get (0x8205) -> blind position element; Sensor Get (0x8231) [4F 00] -> RTR sensor element. Nothing for detectors, push-buttons, gateway. Called by the Devices tab, area detail and app start.

items.title: Analytics for central functions / charts
items.details: Firebase analytics events (central function used, consumption chart type). No mesh traffic.

items.title: Binary input assignment (mini actuator/puck)
items.details: What each input E1/E2 controls (local DB + cached key modes/publications).

items.title: Observe the phone's Bluetooth adapter state
items.details: ObserveBluetoothState (FlowUseCase<Unit, BluetoothState>) feeding MainViewModel.observeBluetoothState (-> BluetoothOffActivity) and BluetoothOffViewModel.observeConnection.

items.title: Observe cloud-sync status (use case)
items.details: ObserveCloudStatus injected into the Devices / Favourites / Areas / Scenes / push-button / mini-actuator / detector view models; offline cloud disables editing controls (CloudStatusWrapperView, cloud_offline_dialog_*).

items.title: Push-button key assignment
items.details: Per key position: press/hold function (from key modes 0x5003 and client publications), shown on the push-button page.

items.title: Observe demo ("Discovery mode") state
items.details: ObserveDemoMode (FlowUseCase<Unit, Boolean>) in DemoModeAwareViewModel (base of Home / Areas / Scenes view models) and MainViewModel: while the demo project is active the toolbars show the exploration indicator (exploration_mode_title="Discovery mode") with an Exit button (action_end_demo_mode). No mesh traffic.

items.title: Observe one device (live state)
items.details: Flow of the device aggregate (capabilities keyed by element address, updated by every status resolver, reachability counter, favourite flag).

items.title: Local device info
items.details: Local per-device info (notes, consumption views enabled, price).

items.title: Observe device lists (sorted)
items.details: Lists filtered by DeviceFilter (All, Lamp, Blind, Rtr, Socket, ControlSwitch, Detector, MiniActuator, IsFavorite, Group, ...) sorted favourites first, then by name.

items.title: Observe area
items.details: Area name/address for central functions and area detail.

items.title: Observe areas
items.details: Areas list (optionally IsFavorite).

items.details: ObserveMeshNetwork in MainViewModel.observeJungMeshNetwork: once the project's mesh network is loaded, RequestSoftwareVersion(AllDevices) and RemoveInvalidDevices run.

items.title: Bottom-bar / settings badge indicators
items.details: Params BottomBar / Settings / Gateway; Indicators GatewayPermission(count of gateway API clients awaiting approval), ParticipantRequests(count, cloud project), ProjectFileModified (project changed, gateway not yet updated), SensorValues (gateway sensor values not yet viewed) -> badge dots on the bottom navigation.

items.title: RTR binding of an output
items.details: RtrConnectionMode(controlled: Boolean, rtrNames): output pages show rtr_connection_info_text + RTR names and hide/disable their controls.

items.title: Observe scene
items.details: Scene detail data.

items.title: Observe scenes
items.details: Scene list (optionally IsFavorite).

items.details: ObserveUpdateAvailable in MainViewModel.observeIndicators: badge on the settings tab when any device has newer bundled firmware.

items.title: Remove an input connection
items.details: Configuration (publication removal).

items.title: Drop mesh nodes without an app device after load
items.details: Admin only and when no BLE process runs: node UUIDs of the mesh network with no app device -> RemoveDevice.ForDevicesWithUUID (local project only, no mesh traffic).

items.title: Unlink heating actuator from RTR
items.details: Config unsubscribe of the actuator OnOff server from the RTR address + Admin Set 0x1014 = 0 on the actuator.

items.title: Lock-function assignment of keys
items.details: Reads the lock-function (0x0009-style KeySetPropertyValue) configured on keys to label them (lock_function_on_subtitle, lock_function_off_subtitle, lock_function_wind_alarm_subtitle, lock_function_lockout_protection_subtitle, lock_function_keep_current_state_connection_subtitle; app/utils/g.j).

items.title: Read identity/version properties for the device info page
items.details: SIG Generic Manufacturer Property Get (0x822B) for 0x0010 hardware revision (and 0x001A software version) -> Generic Manufacturer Property Status 0x46; RTR additionally LBC Manufacturer Get 0x0005 (STM32 / application image version).

items.title: Read the software version of all devices after load
items.details: RequestSoftwareVersion.Params.AllDevices: SIG Generic Manufacturer Property Get 0x001A to every device once the mesh network is loaded (feeds device info and update checks).

items.details: ResetDevice injected into DevicesViewModel / FavoritesViewModel (the invocation, new ResetDevice.Params(device, false), sits in configuration/c.java); failure to reset over the mesh -> device_reset_manually_dialog_title.

items.title: Enter / leave the demo ("Discovery mode") project
items.details: ToggleDemoMode.Params Toggle / Activate / Deactivate; the toolbar Exit button (explorationModeFinishButton, action_end_demo_mode) sends Deactivate. No mesh traffic.

items.title: Toggle on/off (tile action, detail header power button)
items.details: Generic OnOff Set (0x8202, ack) [onoff u8][tid] -> OnOff element; new state = OFF if current is ON or unknown, else ON. Afterwards Admin Get 0x0009 (lock state) if unknown and the node has no Scene Action Setup server. Used by Devices tab, favourites, area detail, lamp/socket detail headers.

items.title: Favourite flag for devices, areas and scenes
items.details: Local DB isFavorite (synced with the project); favourites appear on the Favourites dashboard and are sorted first; favourite devices are the only ones state-loaded at app start.

items.title: Rename device
items.details: Local name update (no mesh traffic).

items.title: Local device notes/flags
items.details: Stores gateway note text / consumption-card flags locally.

items.title: Central function: Dim all lamps of an area
items.details: Light Lightness Set Unacknowledged (0x824D) [lightness u16 = pct/100*65535][tid] -> the area group address (room membership subscribes the Lightness server). One unacknowledged message, no per-device feedback.

items.title: Central function: Dim all lamps (home)
items.details: Light Lightness Set Unacknowledged (0x824D) -> device-type group 0xFEF5 (all lamps). One unacknowledged message, no per-device feedback.

items.title: Central function: All blinds to position (home)
items.details: Generic Level Set Unacknowledged (0x8207) [level s16][tid] -> 0xFEF6 (all blind position elements); open = 0 %, close = 100 %. One unacknowledged message, no per-device feedback.

items.title: Central function: All slats (home)
items.details: Generic Level Set Unacknowledged (0x8207) -> 0xFEF7 (all slat elements). One unacknowledged message, no per-device feedback.

items.title: Central function: Stop all blinds (home)
items.details: Generic Delta Set [delta s32 = LevelStep value, stop = 0] sent without waiting for status -> 0xFEF6. One unacknowledged message, no per-device feedback.

items.title: Central function: Stop blinds of an area
items.details: Generic Delta Set [0] -> area group address. One unacknowledged message, no per-device feedback.

items.title: Central function: All thermostats target temperature (home)
items.details: Generic Level Set Unacknowledged (0x8207) -> 0xFEF9, pct = int((t-5)/25*100) (truncated), level = -32768 + pct/100*65535. One unacknowledged message, no per-device feedback.

items.title: Central function: All lamps on/off (home)
items.details: Generic OnOff Set Unacknowledged (0x8203) [onoff][tid] -> 0xFEF5. One unacknowledged message, no per-device feedback.

items.title: Central function: All sockets on/off (home)
items.details: Generic OnOff Set Unacknowledged (0x8203) -> 0xFEF8. One unacknowledged message, no per-device feedback.

items.details: Local area metadata.

items.title: Blind position slider
items.details: Vertical shutter drawing: shaded part = present position, thumb = target; value sent on release only (0 % open .. 100 % closed).

items.title: Consumption line/bar chart
items.details: Chart of the 0x5010 (24 h, hourly) or 0x5011 (31 days, daily) samples in Wh; invalid samples (0xFFFF) skipped; empty state when no data. Other strings on this surface: common_unit_w="W"; month_format="dd MMM"; time_with_day_format="HH:mm EEE".

items.title: Cloud sync offline indicator
items.details: Shows "offline" (cloud_offline) when project cloud sync is unreachable; editing controls wrapped in CloudStatusWrapperView are disabled and a tap shows cloud_offline_dialog_title / cloud_offline_dialog_message.

items.title: Push-button key assignment card (per key: press / hold)
items.details: Card per key (icons ic_control_switch_key_top_left / _top_center / top_right / bottom_left / bottom_center / bottom_right) with the Interactions header (control_switch_action_title="Interactions") and the Press / Hold (control_switch_item_key_hold="Hold") targets of that key (layout view_control_switch_key_assignment).

items.title: Sleep-mode banner for battery push-buttons
items.details: Banner "Press the button to wake it from power saving mode." (control_switch_sleep_mode_text); info dialog control_switch_sleep_mode_title / control_switch_sleep_mode_dialog_text; "not responding" dialog update_walltransmitter_no_wake_up_title / update_walltransmitter_no_wake_up_text.

items.title: Push-button rocker drawing with key selection and lock markers
items.details: Draws the rocker per ControlSwitchKeyPosition with action indicators (ic_action_indicator_left / _right) and, for keys driving a lock function, lock markers ic_lock_closed / ic_lock_open / ic_lock_wind / ic_lock_disable_wind_alarm.

items.title: Detector activation-area view
items.details: Draws 2 (motion 0x0007/0x0008) or 3 (presence 0x0009) PIR segments labelled A/B/C (pir_sensor_a/b/c_description); segment ring radius = sensitivity 0/25/50/75/100 %; drag changes sensitivity; segment highlighted when its PIR bit is set in 0x6005 during the walking test.

items.title: Detail page header card
items.details: Icon, editable name, subtitle text (state line), status icon slot (battery), favourite toggle, action (power) button, "No connection" label, lock icon. See ui:screen:devicedetailsactivity.

items.title: Device tile (item_device) common behaviour
items.details: Every tile: icon (disabled look when unreachable), name, state text, "No connection" label (device_not_reachable_title) when !S1() && !Q1() (battery devices never show it), skeleton shimmer until the first state is known (OnOff known for OnOff devices, level known for blinds, temperature known for RTR), lock icon when locked (P1()) with ic_lock_wind for wind alarm, favourite star when M1(), action (toggle) button only for GenericOnOffCompatible devices and hidden while locked, checked = on, enabled only when reachable and not RTR-controlled (isActionDisabled via IsAnyRtrDeviceConnected). Selected/highlighted tile colour inversion (y()). Partial redraw payloads: name, reachability, highlight, favourite, OnOff state, lock state, blind level, RTR temperature, button layout. Other strings on this surface: switch_layout_type_1_1_text="Rocker | Rocker"; switch_layout_type_1_2_text="Rocker | Button"; switch_layout_type_2_1_text="Button | Rocker"; switch_layout_type_2_2_text="Button | Button"; switch_layout_type_one_rocker_text="Rocker".

items.title: Brightness slider
items.details: Pill slider 0..100 % showing "%d%%"; range bounds drawn from LightnessRange (min..max); used on the lamp Dim tab and the central lamp tab. Other strings on this surface: unit_percent="%".

items.title: Detector forced ON/OFF banner on the load page
items.details: Hidden for INACTIVE. Title detector_forced_off_on_title "Continuous ON activated" (ON) / detector_forced_off_off_title "Continuous OFF activated" (OFF). Message + image depend on detector product id: 0x0007 -> detector_forced_off_message_short (slider switch to middle), forced_off_off_short/on_short; 0x0008 -> detector_forced_off_on/off_message_long (press ON/OFF button), forced_off_on/off_long; 0x0009 -> detector_forced_off_on/off_message_presence (programming button), forced_off_on/off_presence. Other strings on this surface: detector_forced_off_off_message_long="Press the OFF Button to deactive continous OFF."; detector_forced_off_off_message_presence="Press the programming button to activate continous OFF."; detector_forced_off_on_message_long="Press the ON Button to deactive continous ON."; detector_forced_off_on_message_presence="Press the programming button to activate continous ON.".

items.title: Lock-function card (Permanent On|Off / Lock-out protection / Wind alarm)
items.details: LockType SWITCH: title lock_function_switch_title "Permanent On | Off" + lock_function_switch_description; LockType BLIND: lock_function_lockout_protection_title "Lock-out protection" + description, plus wind-alarm block (lock_function_wind_alarm_title/description, button "Start wind alarm"/"End wind alarm"). Time limit picker H:MM:SS (lock_function_time_limit_title), disabled while locked. Main button "Lock device"/"Unlock device" with ic_function_lock_closed/open. Click: if locked -> unlock (r()); else BLIND type -> startLockOutProtection(duration) (D()), SWITCH -> lockDevice(duration) (o()); wind button -> startWindAlarm (j()) or unlock when wind alarm active. Enable rules: priority LOCKOUT(0xFE) or normal lock -> only unlock allowed; wind alarm (0xFF) -> wind button acts as "End"; unknown state -> follow page enable. Other strings on this surface: lock_device="Lock device"; lock_function_lockout_protection_description="The set position is held permanently and the operation is locked. You can set a time after which the locking function is automatically terminated."; lock_function_wind_alarm_description="The blind moves to the upper end position. Operation is locked during the wind alarm."; lock_function_wind_alarm_start="Start wind alarm"; lock_function_wind_alarm_stop="End wind alarm"; unlock_device="Unlock device".

items.title: Mini-actuator input assignment card (short press / hold)

items.title: Slat angle slider
items.details: Slat position 0..100 % ("%d%%"), sent on release; only for operation mode BLINDS.

items.title: Colour-temperature wheel
items.details: Circular slider 2000..10000 K (layout attrs), label "%s K" rounded to 100 K; range bounds from the CTL temperature range (mapped into the 2..98 % arc).

items.title: Blind: close (down arrow)
items.details: Generic Delta Set (0x8209, acked) [delta s32 LE = +1][tid] -> position element (LevelStep Increase=+1); skipped when already at 100 %. No Generic Move Set anywhere in the app.
