items.details: Generic Delta Set (0x8209, acked) [delta = -1][tid] -> position element (LevelStep Decrease=-1); skipped when already at 0 %.

items.title: Blind page open: read position, slat, operation mode
items.details: On first device emission: Generic Level Get (0x8205, ack) -> position element; Generic Level Get -> slat element (last element with 0x1002 server); LBC Admin Property Get 0x1104 BlindMoveOperationMode (C2 27 05 [04 11]). Controls stay disabled until these answered. Status Generic Level Status 0x8208 [present s16][target s16][remaining u8]: pct=round((level+32768)*100/65535); target := present for the short form.

items.title: Blind: stop
items.details: Generic Delta Set (0x8209, acked) [delta = 0] -> position element (LevelStep Stop).

items.title: Blind: set position (slider release)
items.details: Generic Level Set (0x8206, acked) [level s16 LE][tid], no transition, level = clamp(round(-32768 + pct/100*65535)) -> position element. 0 % = open, 100 % = closed.

items.title: Blind: set slat angle (slider release)
items.details: Generic Level Set (0x8206, acked) -> slat element, same percent->level mapping. BLINDS mode (0x1104=0) only; disabled while blind is fully open.

items.title: Bluetooth-off screen: wait for adapter
items.details: ObserveBluetoothState; finishes BluetoothOffActivity when the adapter is on again.

items.title: Central control: collect devices per type
items.details: ObserveDevices(filter = whole home, or DeviceFilter.Group(groupAddress) for an area) -> decides which of the lamp/socket/blind/RTR tabs exist; the area device list is used for per-device fan-out.

items.title: Central control: resolve area
items.details: Observes the area (group) for its name (central_function_description_in_group "in %s") and address.

items.title: Consumption settings: price input
items.details: Electricity price entry in cents per kWh (consumption_price_edit_label / consumption_price_edit_sub_label), stored locally; preview card shows cost of 100 Wh.

items.title: Consumption settings: card switches
items.details: Local DeviceInfo flags: show Current Power card, show Energy/Total consumption card, show Electricity cost card on the consumption page (socket_configuration_consumption_title).

items.title: Consumption settings: total preview
items.details: Updates the total-consumption / cost preview when 0x006A changes.

items.title: Consumption settings open: read counters
items.details: Acked reads: Sensor Get 0x0081 active power, SIG Generic Admin Property Get 0x006D power-on time, 0x822D 0x006A total energy (previews).

items.title: Reset energy counters
items.details: Button socket_reset_total_consumption ("Reset"): SIG Generic Admin Property Set (0x48, ack) 0x006D power-on time = 0, then 0x006A total energy = 0 ([pid u16][access 03][value LE 0]).

items.title: Push-button page: key card state
items.details: Derives which key-assignment cards are shown/enabled (reachable, awake, role, cloud).

items.title: Push-button page: per-key state
items.details: Maps each rocker/key position to its assignment text (Press/Hold -> function or "No interaction").

items.title: Push-button page: key assignment
items.details: ObserveControlSwitchKeyAssignment (local DB + cached publications/Key modes) for the selected key.

items.title: Push-button page: device
items.details: ObserveDevice; on first emission triggers requestBatteryAndLockFunction.

items.title: Push-button page: local notes
items.details: ObserveDeviceInfo (gateway connection note text shown in gatewayConnectionNotes).

items.title: Push-button page: sleep flag
items.details: Listens to the shared isInSleepModeChannel fed by the keep-alive (SleepMode) to disable editing while the transmitter sleeps.

items.title: Push-button page: items
items.details: Builds the key list (layout from ButtonLayout 0x5001, LayoutMode).

items.title: Push-button page: read battery + lock targets
items.details: Generic Battery Get (0x8223) -> primary element, CommunicationType REQUEST, waitForStatus=false; status 0x8224 -> BatteryCapability (only flags bits 3:2 battery indicator used). Then requestLockFunction.

items.title: Push-button page: read lock functions of assigned keys
items.details: RequestLockFunctionForControlKeySelection: reads the 0x0009 lock-function setting of keys assigned to lock functions (to label them "Duration On/Off", "Lockout protection", "Wind alarm").

items.title: Leave the demo project (toolbar Exit)
items.details: ToggleDemoMode.Params.Deactivate from the exploration indicator's Exit button on Home / Areas / Scenes.

items.title: Toggle the demo project
items.details: ToggleDemoMode.Params.Toggle.

items.title: Detector page open: walking-test flag + PIR poll
items.details: Admin Get 0x6001 PresenceTest (ack) on first emission; while the test flag is true starts FlowOperatorsKt repeating job every 1000 ms: LBC Manufacturer Property Get 0x6005 PresenceControlPir (C8 27 05 [05 60]); stops when false.

items.title: Detector: PIR bits -> segment highlight
items.details: Status CB 27 05 [05 60][access][u8]: bit0 PIR A, bit1 PIR B, bit2 PIR C -> DetectorView highlights; only during the walking test.

items.title: Detector page open: read PIR sensitivities
items.details: Admin Get 0x6008, 0x6009 (+0x600A presence detector) sequentially, ack; status u8 raw 0..255 -> pct = raw*100/255 shown as 0/25/50/75/100 %.

items.title: Detail page: firmware update available
items.details: CheckForDeviceUpdate for this node; if newer firmware -> snackbar update_available_snackbar_title with action update_available_snackbar_action_text (opens UpdateActivity NavigateToGroup).

items.title: Detail page: observe device + read lock state
items.details: ObserveDevice; on first emission for LockFunctionCompatible devices sends LBC Admin Property Get 0x0009 (C2 27 05 [09 00], ack) to read the lock function.

items.title: Detail page: favourite star
items.details: ToggleFavorite (local DB isFavorite); snackbar favorite_device_add_snackbar_message / favorite_device_remove_snackbar_message; haptic feedback. No mesh traffic.

items.title: Detail page: rename device
items.details: Local DB (and cloud/gateway sync) name update after 300 ms debounce; failure dialog device_detail_error_change_name_failed_title / _message. No mesh traffic.

items.title: Device info: update available links
items.details: CheckForDeviceUpdate -> shows "(Update available)" (update_available_link) next to software version and STM32 version.

items.title: Device info: devices
items.details: ObserveDevices for the node; on load RequestManufacturerInfos (SIG Generic Manufacturer Property Get 0x822B for 0x0010 hardware revision / 0x001A software version; RTR: Manufacturer 0x0005 STM32 version).

items.title: Device info: areas count
items.details: Areas the device belongs to (DeviceInfoStatusCard "x / y").

items.title: Tile: toggle disabled when RTR-controlled
items.details: IsAnyRtrDeviceConnected(deviceId): true if an RTR OnOff client publishes to this output -> tile action disabled.

items.title: Devices tab: cloud status
items.details: ObserveCloudStatus -> enables/disables long-press editing.

items.title: Devices tab: list + state load
items.details: ObserveDevices(DeviceFilter for the tab) sorted favourites first then name; LoadStateForDevices for the listed devices; emits UnreachableIndicesEvent.

items.title: Dim tab: render lightness
items.details: Present lightness % (round(l*100/65535)) -> slider/header, on main thread.

items.title: Dim tab: slider -> Lightness Set
items.details: Flow 1: slider state sampled every 500 ms -> Light Lightness Set (0x824C, ack) [lightness u16 LE = round(pct/100*65535)][tid] -> Lightness element. Flow 2: incoming Lightness Status debounced 300 ms -> display.

items.title: Dim tab open: read range + level
items.details: Light Lightness Range Get (0x8257, ack) -> status 0x8258 [status][min u16][max u16] (slider bounds) and Light Lightness Get (0x824B, ack) -> 0x824E.

items.title: Favourites tile: RTR-controlled check
items.details: Same as DevicesViewModel.isActionDisabled (IsAnyRtrDeviceConnected).

items.title: Favourites: cloud status
items.details: ObserveCloudStatus for editing permissions.

items.title: Favourites: combine favourite devices/areas/scenes
items.details: ObserveDevices(IsFavorite) + ObserveGroups(IsFavorite) + ObserveScenes(IsFavorite) + search text -> three sections.

items.title: Area: create (admin)
items.details: CreateGroup (allocates group address, subscribes devices) - configuration domain; errors group_detail_error_create_failed_*.

items.title: Area tile: RTR-controlled check
items.details: IsAnyRtrDeviceConnected for tile toggles.

items.title: Area detail: observe area
items.details: ObserveGroup (name, icon, favourite, address).

items.title: Area detail: name uniqueness
items.details: ObserveGroups for duplicate-name validation (group_detail_name_already_taken_error).

items.title: Area detail: devices + state load
items.details: ObserveDevices(DeviceFilter.Group) and LoadStateForDevices for them.

items.title: Area favourite
items.details: ToggleFavorite for the group; snackbar favorite_group_add/remove_snackbar_message.

items.title: Area icon
items.details: UpdateGroup icon (local).

items.title: Area rename
items.details: UpdateGroup name (local); errors group_detail_error_update_failed_*.

items.title: Areas tab: cloud status
items.details: ObserveCloudStatus.

items.title: Areas tab: list
items.details: ObserveGroups -> GroupItem (name, icon, device count, favourite).

items.title: Home: compute visible filter tabs
items.details: From all devices + admin role: FAVORITE if any device; LAMP/BLIND/RTR/SOCKET if such exist; CONTROL_SWITCH/DETECTOR/MINI_ACTUATOR only for admins.

items.title: Home: select filter tab
items.details: Stores the selected DeviceFilterView in deviceFilterChannel; falls back to the first visible tab when an admin-only tab disappears.

items.title: Battery device keep-alive
items.details: KeepLowPowerDeviceAwake: while the page is open and no other BLE process runs, acked LBC Admin Property Get 0x5001 ButtonLayout (C2 27 05 [01 50]) every 6 s; success -> SleepMode.DeviceAwake, timeout -> DeviceNotAwake (+ retry after 1 s); third state DeviceNotAvailable makes the page cancel the keep-alive job (work body only recoverable in jadx simple mode; timings per docs/android/network-logic.md 5.4).

items.title: Lamp page: detector forced ON/OFF
items.details: For loads attached to a detector insert (DeviceFilter.AttachmentWithInsert): LBC Admin Property Get 0x6016 ForcedOff (ack) -> detector element; status u8 0 INACTIVE, 2 OFF, 3 ON -> ForcedOffView.

items.title: Lamp page: combine RTR binding + forced mode
items.details: ObserveRtrConnectionMode + forced-off -> enable controls only if !rtrControlled && forced == INACTIVE; RTR card text.

items.title: Lock device (keep current state) with time limit
items.details: LBC Admin Property Set 0x0009 (C3 27 05, ack) [09 00][userAccess 03][cmd 02 = lock current][priority 01][time u16 LE seconds, 0 = unlimited].

items.title: Blind lock-out protection with time limit
items.details: Admin Set 0x0009 [09 00][03][cmd 02][priority FE][time u16 LE s] (keeps the hanging position).

items.title: Blind wind alarm start
items.details: Admin Set 0x0009 [09 00][03][cmd 01 = enforce value][priority FF][time 00 00][value 00 00] (move to 0 % = open/upper end and lock, no time limit). End = unlockDevice.

items.title: Unlock device / end wind alarm / end lock-out
items.details: Admin Set 0x0009 [09 00][03][cmd 00][previous priority][previous time][previous value...].

items.title: App: Bluetooth adapter state
items.details: ObserveBluetoothState -> opens BluetoothOffActivity when off; location permission dialog permissions_import_dialog_title/body when needed.

items.title: App: bottom-bar bubbles
items.details: ObserveProjectBubbleIndicators / ObserveUpdateAvailable / participant requests -> badge dots on bottom navigation items (settings: updates available, pending requests).

items.title: App: mesh network loaded
items.details: ObserveMeshNetwork; triggers RequestSoftwareVersion and RemoveInvalidDevices after load.

items.title: App: new user-role banner
items.details: CheckNewUserModeBanner -> Banner snackbar user_mode_new_banner_title + _message_admin / _message_member, action user_mode_new_banner_action_text (opens UserModeInfoActivity).

items.title: App: connect to mesh proxy
items.details: ConnectToProxy (GATT proxy scan/connect, reconnect loop); drives ProxyStatusView and the loading screen.

items.title: Inputs page: assignment
items.details: ObserveBinaryInputAssignment for E1/E2 (what each input controls).

items.title: Inputs page: device
items.details: ObserveDevice; on first emission triggers requestBattery/requestKeyModes/requestInputDetections/requestPropertyConnections.

items.title: Inputs page: notes
items.details: ObserveDeviceInfo (gateway note).

items.title: Inputs page: reload after change
items.details: Re-reads the device after a configuration change.

items.title: Inputs page: remove input connections
items.details: Removes the publications/links of an input (configuration).

items.title: Inputs page: battery (battery puck 0x0016)
items.details: Generic Battery Get (0x8223) REQUEST, waitForStatus=false -> BatteryCapability indicator.

items.title: Inputs page: edge detection
items.details: Admin Get 0x5009 InputEdgeDetection (ack) -> rising/falling edge display.

items.title: Inputs page: key modes
items.details: Admin Get 0x5003 KeyMode per input element (ack).

items.title: Inputs page: property links
items.details: Admin Get 0x5006 / 0x5007 KeySetPropertyValue Up/Down per input (ack).

items.title: Inputs page: selected input
items.details: Tracks selected input E1/E2 card.

items.title: Inputs page: connect inputs switch
items.details: Changes the input layout (E1+E2 combined vs separate) - configuration.

items.title: Rename dialog: current device name
items.details: ObserveDevice -> prefills the device's project name.

items.title: Rename dialog: current area name
items.details: ObserveGroup -> prefills the area's name.

items.title: Rename dialog: current scene name
items.details: ObserveScene -> prefills the scene's name.

items.title: Rename dialog: save
items.details: UpdateDeviceData / UpdateGroup / UpdateSceneName with the new name (CheckNameInput errors shown inline). Project meta only, no mesh traffic.

items.title: Consumption: enable state
items.details: Combines reachability and RTR binding to enable the page controls.

items.title: Consumption page open: start 5 s polling + chart load
items.details: Starts FlowOperatorsKt.h repeating job (requestData) every 5 s while open, and requestConsumptionData on spinner change.

items.title: Consumption: card visibility
items.details: Local DeviceInfo flags (set on the configuration consumption page) decide which of total consumption / operating hours / price cards show.

items.title: Consumption: price
items.details: Local price per kWh in cents -> cost = (price/100) * (totalEnergy Wh / 1000) EUR, "%.2f €".

items.title: Consumption: total energy
items.details: Recomputes the cost when the total energy value changes.

items.title: Consumption chart load
items.details: LBC User Property Get (CE 27 05) 0x5010 (DAILY, 24 hourly u16 BE samples x0.1, 0xFFFF invalid) or 0x5011 (THIRTY_ONE_DAYS, u24 BE x0.1 per day); logs analytics event; segmented reply D1 27 05.

items.title: Consumption 5 s poll
items.details: Sequential acked: SIG Generic Admin Property Get (0x822D) 0x006D power-on time (hours) -> 0x4A; 0x822D 0x006A total energy (Wh, LE int) -> 0x4A; Sensor Get (0x8231) [81 00] -> Sensor Status 0x0081 active power LE x0.1 W.

items.title: Blind reference run (calibration) start
items.details: When the ReferenceRun capability is requested: LBC Admin Property Set 0x110D ReferenceRun [01] (ack) to the blind; then waitForReferenceRun.

items.title: Blind reference run: wait
items.details: Waits BlindMoveUpDownTime (Admin 0x1102, s) + 10 s, nothing is read back (no calibration status property); screen text blind_reference_run_description.

items.title: RTR: select Comfort / ECO / Frost (FW >= 2.2.0.0)
items.details: LBC Admin Property Set 0x120B RtrHvacMode (C3 27 05 [0B 12][03][mode u8], ack): 1 COMFORT, 2 ECO, 3 FREEZE. Older firmware (no 0x120B support): the preset temperature (0x1203/0x1204/0x1205) is written as the new target via Level Set.

items.title: RTR: slider value input
items.details: Pushes the slider value into a StateFlow; see observeTemperatureToUpdate.

items.title: RTR: minus button
items.details: target - 0.5 degC (clamped 5..30) -> same path as the slider.

items.title: RTR: list bound heating actuators
items.details: GetConnectedDevices (local DB: outputs whose OnOff server subscribes to the RTR OnOff-client publish address) -> compose list.

items.title: RTR: plus button
items.details: target + 0.5 degC (clamped 5..30).

items.title: RTR page open: reads + 5 s boost poll
items.details: One-shot: requestTemperature, requestRtrModes, requestSchedulerEnabledValue; then FlowOperatorsKt.h repeating requestBoostFunction every 5 s while open. Mode shown = HvacMode from 0x120B, or on old FW the preset (Comfort/ECO/Frost) equal to the current target.

items.title: RTR: sample slider 500 ms
items.details: StateFlow sampled every 500 ms -> updateTargetTemperature.

items.title: RTR: unlink heating actuator
items.details: RemoveMultiConnection (config unsubscribe + Admin Set 0x1014 = 0 on the actuator); dialogs remove_rtr_connection_*.

items.title: RTR: read boost
items.details: LBC Admin Property Get 0x120D BoostMode (ack), polled every 5 s; status u8 1 active / 0 off.

items.title: RTR: read mode/presets
items.details: FW >= 2.2.0.0: Admin Get 0x120B RtrHvacMode; else Admin Get 0x1203 Comfort, 0x1204 Eco, 0x1205 Frost preset (int16 LE degC x100).

items.title: RTR: read Auto/Manu
items.details: Admin Get 0x1246 SchedulerEnabled (ack); u8 1 = AUTO, 0 = MANU.

items.title: RTR: read current + target temperature
items.details: Sensor Get (0x8231) [4F 00] -> sensor element (Present Ambient Temperature, raw s8 x0.5 degC clamped 5..30) and Generic Level Get (0x8205) -> set-point element (t = 5 + 25*pct/100).

items.title: RTR: toggle Auto/Manu
items.details: Admin Set 0x1246 SchedulerEnabled [46 12][03][01|00] (ack) = inverse of current.

items.title: RTR: start/stop boost
items.details: Admin Set 0x120D BoostMode [0D 12][03][01|00] (ack); boost = full heating power for 5 minutes, slider + mode buttons disabled meanwhile.

items.title: RTR: send target temperature
items.details: Generic Level Set (0x8206, ack) -> set-point element: pct = round((t-5)/25*100), level = clamp(round(-32768 + pct/100*65535)); 0.5 degC UI steps (~0.25 degC resolution on air).

items.title: Scene detail: RTR-controlled marks
items.details: IsAnyRtrDeviceConnected per listed device -> "Temperature-controlled" label.

items.title: Scene detail: build result list
items.details: Maps stored scene actions to display rows (state per device).

items.title: Scene detail: observe
items.details: ObserveScene (name, icon, favourite, members).

items.title: Scene favourite
items.details: ToggleFavorite for the scene; snackbar favorite_scene_add/remove_snackbar_message.

items.title: Scene detail: edit list
items.details: Scene editing (scenes domain).

items.title: Scene detail: save
items.details: Scene editing / store (scenes domain); errors scene_detail_error_*.

items.title: Scene icon picker: current icon
items.details: ObserveScene -> highlights the scene's current icon.

items.title: Scenes tab: cloud status
items.details: ObserveCloudStatus.

items.title: Scenes tab: list
items.details: ObserveScenes -> tiles (name, number, isFavorite, icon).

items.title: Switch tab: state
items.details: Combines device OnOff, lock function, RTR binding, reachability into the compose UI state.

items.title: Switch tab: lock time-limit picker
items.details: Opens the duration picker (JungDurationPickerDialog, max 4 h 59 min 59 s) for the lock time limit - not a timed-on.

items.title: Switch tab open: read OnOff if unknown
items.details: Generic OnOff Get (0x8201) REQUEST, waitForStatus=false -> OnOff element, only if no cached OnOff state.

items.title: Switch tab: exposed state
items.details: StateFlow for the compose screen (illustration on/off, lock button text Lock/Unlock, time limit).

items.title: Colour temperature: wheel -> CTL Set
items.details: Wheel value debounced 500 ms -> Light CTL Set (0x825E, ack) [lightness u16 = current lightness][temperature K u16][deltaUV s16 = 0][tid]; Light CTL Temperature Set 0x8264 never used. K = round((2000 + 8000*pct/100)/100)*100.

items.title: Colour temperature tab open: read range + CTL
items.details: Light CTL Temperature Range Get (0x8262, ack) -> 0x8263 [status][min K][max K]; Light CTL Get (0x825D, ack) -> Light CTL Status 0x8260 (present lightness, present temperature).
